items.q: What do I need to have ready to start?
items.a: Your business texts, your logo if you have one, and the photos you want to use. If you don't have photos, we use free professional images or generate them with AI.

items.q: Does it include hosting and domain?
items.a: Deploy on Vercel is free and included. The domain (.com.ar costs ~$3,000/year at NIC.ar) you register or I help you with that.

items.q: Can I request changes after delivery?
items.a: Yes, I include up to 2 rounds of corrections at no additional cost within the first 7 days of delivery.
